raw_findings.verbatim_quote:
Global rstSuppliers As ADODB.Recordset
Sub MakeRW()
    DoCmd.OpenForm 'Suppliers'
    Set rstSuppliers = New ADODB.Recordset

raw_findings.key_implication: Microsoft's OWN example uses Global-scope recordset variable, NOT Dim'd-locally; this is exactly the upstream fix pattern Concern 4 recommended in PR #139 (switch tRstStatus from Dim'd-local to global per gRstPeople precedent at line 1184)

raw_findings.topic: Form.Recordset self-rebinding workaround for unbound-form symptom
verbatim_quotes: Changing a form's Recordset property may also change the RecordSource, RecordsetType, and RecordLocks properties. Also, some data-related properties may be overridden, for example, the Filter, FilterOn, OrderBy, and OrderByOn properties.

Calling the Requery method of a form's recordset (for example, Forms(0).Recordset.Requery) can cause the form to become unbound. To refresh the data in a form bound to a recordset, set the RecordSource property of the form to itself: Forms(0).RecordSource = Forms(0).RecordSource.
raw_findings.key_implication: this is a NEW Microsoft-documented workaround we did NOT test in any of PR #129/#132/#133/#134/#135/#136/#137; the strongest 'one more local probe could be justified' signal in the evidence
raw_findings.caveat: the doc frames self-rebinding as a fix for 'form becomes unbound' symptom; whether it ALSO addresses the per-form-instance event-binding cache (PR #137's pinned layer) is not stated in the docs; technique is a candidate for a focused probe, not a guaranteed fix

raw_findings.topic: Form-module Public sub addressability from standard modules
raw_findings.consensus_summary: form-module Public subs are NOT addressable from standard modules via Application.Run; documented escape is 'Call Forms!FormName.PublicSubName' from VBA execution context; alternatively move shared logic to standard modules
raw_findings.key_implication: corroborates F1 from independent community source; even with Public wrapper trick, app.Run('Form_LookAtStatus.RunExportPajek') won't work; the Forms!FormName.SubName form requires VBA execution context, not external COM

raw_findings.topic: Local Dim DAO recordset scope -> Object required
raw_findings.consensus_summary: 'Object required' typically occurs when local recordset variable goes out of scope before form finishes using it; recommended fix is to keep recordset alive at module-level or global scope
raw_findings.key_implication: corroborates F3 (Microsoft's Global example) from community consensus; directly supports Concern 4's upstream fix recommendation (switch tRstStatus to global per gRstPeople precedent)

raw_findings.topic: Form.RecordSource = Form.RecordSource self-rebinding (community corroboration of F4)
raw_findings.consensus_summary: self-rebinding pattern recommended in community threads when Set Form.Recordset = <recordset> followed by Requery / Close causes binding loss
raw_findings.key_implication: corroborates F4 from independent Tier-2 source; adds confidence that the technique is real and working, not theoretical

raw_findings.topic: Close + reopen form to refresh event handlers after runtime VBA injection
raw_findings.source_summary: anecdotal forum threads (Access 2007/2010 era) suggest close+reopen as last-resort fix for AddFromString-style runtime injection causing event handlers to not bind correctly; no canonical source endorses
raw_findings.key_implication: consistent with PR #137's verdict-note ranking 'close + reopen form' as the most-likely-to-work remaining local candidate, but does NOT independently strengthen the case beyond what we already had
raw_findings.credibility_caveat: version-specific, anecdotal, no Tier-1 or Tier-2 corroboration

I1_concern_4_fix_is_microsoft_documented.summary: F3 (Microsoft's own Form.Recordset example uses Global-scope recordset) AND F7 (community consensus on local-Dim recordset scope) BOTH point at the same fix shape: hold the recordset variable at Global (or at minimum module-level) scope, NOT Dim'd-locally inside the sub that assigns it to a subform's .Form.Recordset.  Concern 4's suggested upstream fix (switch tRstStatus from Dim'd-local to global per gRstPeople precedent at Form_LookAtStatus.vb:1184) IS exactly the Microsoft-documented best practice.

I2_pr136_application_run_boundary_is_by_.summary: F1 (official doc syntax) AND F6 (community consensus on form-module sub addressability) both confirm that PR #136's app.Run('Form_LookAtStatus.RunExportPajek') was attempting an undocumented form.  No escape valve at this layer that we missed.

I3_pr131_134_mechanism_boundary_is_by_mi.summary: F2's official wording -- 'The Requery method doesn't pass control to the operating system... Use the DoEvents function if you need to relinquish temporary control' -- is consistent with our empirical finding that VBA-side DoEvents loops don't release the COM thread the way Python time.sleep does.  The mechanism boundary is real, documented, and not a bug we missed.

I4_one_microsoft_documented_local_techni.summary: F4 (official doc) + F8 (community corroboration) describe one Microsoft-documented local technique we did NOT test in PR #129/#132/#133/#134/#135/#136/#137.  Per PR #137's evidence the underlying issue is at Access's per-form-instance event-binding cache after AddFromString -- but the RecordSource = RecordSource technique addresses a different failure surface (recordset-becomes-unbound, not event-binding-cache-stale).  Plausible but not certain that combining the two would unblock.  Strongest 'one more local probe could be justified' signal in the evidence -- but recorded as optional unpause path, NOT a recommendation to keep the line in active development.

I5_addfromstring_event_binding_cache_is_.summary: F5's absence-of-doc + PR #137's empirical evidence + F9's Tier-3 close+reopen anecdote suggest this layer has no documented escape.  Pursuing it further locally would be heuristic / version-specific -- exactly the kind of fragility we want to avoid in a test driver.

I6_microsoft_recommended_workaround_for_.summary: F3 + F4 collectively show Microsoft's own guidance for 'Form.Recordset assigned to local recordset, then needs refresh' is: declare at Global scope (F3) OR use RecordSource = RecordSource self-rebinding (F4).  The Status form's existing gRstPeople global at line 1184 already follows F3.  Applying the same pattern to tRstStatus (the cleanup-rebind variable) is the documented fix -- not opaque maintainer-prerogative; documented Microsoft pattern.

verdict_rationale: The dominant external evidence (F3 + F4 + F7 + F8) all converge on the same conclusion: the upstream fix Concern 4 recommends (switch tRstStatus from Dim'd-local to global) IS the Microsoft-documented best practice.  The 7-PR local-workaround chain's exhaustion is not just empirical -- it's also documented (F1+F6 confirm Application.Run is by design; F2 confirms VBA-side DoEvents != COM-side OS-yield; F5+F9 confirm the AddFromString event-binding-cache layer is undocumented and version-specific).  The maintainer-line handoff is well-grounded in canonical sources.
